full.description: This is a micrograph showing a section of human skin and subcutaneous tissue. The epidermis at the surface appears flattened and stretched, consistent with the effects of a thermal burn. The underlying dermis and subcutaneous fat show architectural alterations and thermal artifact. The most likely diagnosis is thermal burned skin.

blind.description: This is a micrograph of skin tissue. It shows a circumscribed nodule located in the superficial dermis on acral skin, characterized by mucin deposition between spindle and stellate cells. The lesion lacks an epithelial lining at its well-demarcated periphery. These histological features are most consistent with a digital mucous cyst.

random.description: This image is a histological micrograph showing skin or breast tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It displays prominent adipose tissue (fat) underlying a fibrous layer or dermis, with some vascular structures visible.
